name: Arsenal
description: Weapon attack and family identities. Attack set per weapon for the story timing on a gentle climb; Warrior axes, Time Mage hammers and bombs brought into line. Identities that change speed, combo or critical rate are offset in attack (damage-neutral); identities that add an effect: sword evade, pole evade, hammer Disable and knockback, greatsword knockback, hand-bomb Slow/Oil, ninja-sword Blind, spear reach. Spears have no weapon evade; hammers and crossbows charge slower. Flame, Diamond and Dragon Shields trade evade for magick evade. Hornito, the Time Mage opening hand-bomb, is priced like the other opening weapons.
